name: Maui
about: Apr–May and Sep–Oct are the sweet spots — good weather with fewer crowds than the winter and summer peaks.
overview: Black-sand beaches, the Road to Hana, and Haleakalā's volcanic summit, all on one of Hawaii's most popular islands.
costOverview: Everyday food and coffee run at real US-island prices — a proper snorkel tour to Molokini is the one big-ticket activity most people build a day around.

specialSeasons.text: Humpback whales gather in the channel between Maui and Lanai to breed and calve, often visible from shore.
